title: Spider-Man
tagline: The first Marvel video game, written by one programmer.
summary: Laura Nikolich programmed a vertical climber for the Atari 2600. Spider-Man scales a building the Green Goblin has trapped with bombs. Parker Brothers published it. It is the first Spider-Man game and the first Marvel game.
gameplay: A single-screen vertical scramble. Spider-Man moves between windows, avoids hazards, and defuses bombs before the Goblin’s trap closes.
